features: ULTRAWIDE PRODUCTIVITY DISPLAY - 34-inch 21:9 UltraWide WQHD (3440 x 1440) monitor provides up to 33% more screen space than standard QHD displays, making multitasking, spreadsheets, content creation, coding, and work-from-home setups more efficient

IMMERSIVE 1800R CURVED SCREEN - Designed with a 1800R curvature that follows your natural field of vision, reducing eye movement while delivering a more immersive viewing experience for work, entertainment, and gaming.

SMOOTH 120HZ PERFORMANCE - Experience fluid visuals with a 120Hz refresh rate, ensuring smoother scrolling, responsive workflow, seamless video playback, and improved gaming performance with reduced motion blur.

HDR10 & sRGB 99% COLOR ACCURACY - Enjoy vibrant colors, enhanced contrast, and accurate image reproduction with HDR10 support and 99% sRGB color gamut coverage, ideal for content consumption, photo editing, and professional work.
AMD FREESYNC PREMIUM GAMING - AMD FreeSync Premium technology minimizes screen tearing and stuttering, delivering smoother gameplay and low-latency performance for an enhanced gaming experience.

EYE CARE FEATURES FOR ALL-DAY USE - Equipped with Flicker Safe technology and Anti-Glare coating to reduce screen flickering and reflections, helping minimize eye fatigue during extended working or entertainment sessions.
3-SIDE VIRTUALLY BORDERLESS DESIGN - Sleek bezel design maximizes screen space and provides a cleaner, modern setup while enabling a more seamless multi-monitor experience.

IDEAL FOR WORK, ENTERTAINMENT & CONTENT CREATION - The UltraWide 21:9 aspect ratio allows you to view multiple windows side-by-side, making it perfect for professionals, creators, stock traders, programmers, and multitaskers.
FLEXIBLE CONNECTIVITY OPTIONS - Connect laptops, desktops, gaming consoles, and other devices effortlessly with HDMI and DisplayPort inputs, ensuring broad compatibility for home and office setups.

ERGONOMIC & MODERN WORKSPACE DESIGN - Tilt-adjustable stand combined with a premium curved screen design lets you customize your viewing angle for improved comfort and productivity throughout the day.
